ourServices.description: Comprehensive fertility care under one roof — from diagnosis and IVF to advanced genetic testing, guided personally by Dr. Mona Dahiya.

items.title: In vitro Fertilization (IVF)
items.description: Lab fertilisation of eggs and sperm with carefully timed embryo transfer for the best chance of pregnancy.

items.title: Intrauterine Insemination (IUI)
items.description: Prepared sperm placed directly into the uterus around ovulation — a simple first-line fertility option.

items.title: Follicular Ultrasound
items.description: Cycle monitoring to track follicle growth and pinpoint the ideal window for IUI, IVF or timed intercourse.

items.title: Tests for Infertility
items.description: Complete female fertility work-up including hormones, ultrasound and tubes assessment under one plan.

items.title: Male Infertility Tests
items.description: Semen analysis, DNA fragmentation and advanced male factor evaluation with clear next-step guidance.

items.title: Mini IVF
items.description: Gentle, lower-stimulation IVF designed for selected patients who need a softer, more affordable approach.

items.title: Laparoscopy & Hysteroscopy
items.description: Keyhole surgery to treat endometriosis, fibroids, polyps and blocked tubes that affect fertility.

items.title: Low AMH Treatment
items.description: Personalised protocols for diminished ovarian reserve to maximise egg quality and pregnancy chances.

items.title: Embryo Cryopreservation
items.description: Safe freezing of embryos for future FET cycles, fertility preservation or family planning later.

items.title: Endometrial Receptivity Array
items.description: ERA testing to find your personal implantation window after failed transfers or thin lining concerns.

items.title: Donor Gametes
items.description: Carefully screened donor egg or sperm programmes when own gametes are not an option for parenthood.

items.title: Preimplantation Genetic Testing
items.description: PGT screening of embryos for chromosomal or genetic conditions before transfer for safer IVF outcomes.

faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about IVF treatment, process, safety, success rates and more.

leftFaqs.question: Who offers the best IVF treatment in India?
leftFaqs.answer: Dr. Mona Dahiya is a leading choice for couples in India and from abroad who want affordable IVF with high success rates. With personalized care, advanced technology, and a patient-first approach, she has helped many couples achieve their dream of parenthood.

leftFaqs.question: What is the success rate of IVF in India?
leftFaqs.answer: The success rate of IVF varies depending on maternal age, diagnosis, and medical history, generally ranging between 50% to 80% with advanced blastocyst culture and individualized protocols under Dr. Mona Dahiya.

leftFaqs.question: Is IVF safe after 35?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, IVF is safe after 35. Comprehensive pre-treatment assessments, genetic screening, and tailored stimulation protocols ensure both mother and baby receive optimal medical care.

leftFaqs.question: Which month is best for IVF?
leftFaqs.answer: There is no medically specific best month for IVF; success is determined by ovarian reserve, hormonal balance, and personalized preparation rather than seasonal factors.

leftFaqs.question: How many IVF cycles are needed to get pregnant?
leftFaqs.answer: Many couples conceive in their first cycle, while others may require 2 to 3 cycles. Dr. Mona optimizes each protocol based on previous responses to achieve pregnancy in minimal attempts.

rightFaqs.question: Is IVF harmful or beneficial?
rightFaqs.answer: IVF is a clinically proven, safe medical procedure that has enabled millions of families worldwide to experience parenthood when natural conception is challenging.

rightFaqs.question: How safe is IVF pregnancy in India?
rightFaqs.answer: IVF pregnancies in certified fertility centres are closely monitored by expert obstetricians and fertility specialists with international safety standards.

rightFaqs.question: How can I share my medical records?
rightFaqs.answer: You can securely share your test reports and medical history via WhatsApp (+91 92679 82924) or email directly to info@drmonadahiya.com before your consultation.

rightFaqs.question: What if I don't have previous medical records?
rightFaqs.answer: You don't need prior records. Dr. Mona will conduct a fresh, complete diagnostic assessment for both partners to determine the best treatment path.

rightFaqs.question: Which documents should I carry for treatment?
rightFaqs.answer: Please carry valid government photo IDs (Aadhaar/Passport/Voter ID), marriage proof (for ART compliance), and any prior ultrasound or blood reports if available.

rightFaqs.question: What is the Indian country code?
rightFaqs.answer: The international dialling code for India is +91.
